Wishing you nothing but the Best.

Thank you to the entire Addis Cars team for making this a memorable and hassle-free experience. Definitely recommended for anyone planning to buy a car!

Extremely Disappointed – Unfair Inspection & Misleading Sales Tactics

I had a very bad experience with CARS24 while trying to sell my Suzuki Swift ZXI AMT 2021.

Yesterday, I booked an inspection hoping to get a fair market value for my car. Today, Mr. Milind Raut visited my home and completed the inspection. After finishing, he strongly advised me to purchase the Pro Seller Plan (₹1060 incl. GST), saying that:

My car would go for a Pan-India auction

I would get a better price

I could download the detailed inspection report

Both ORVMs

Headlights

Taillights

Fog lamps

Leather seats

None of these have any scratches or damage — they are in flawless working condition. I have taken screenshots of the entire inspection report as proof.

Because of this incorrect and misleading report, I was offered a price that was significantly lower than my expectation.

Why were those false damages added in the first place?

Why was the car quoted with wrong information including a missing spare key?

Why should I pay for a Pro Seller plan if the inspection itself is inaccurate?

He finally said he could offer only up to 10% more than the initial low quote, which still does not justify the unfair valuation.

From my overall experience, it clearly feels like inspection reports are intentionally exaggerated with false damages to bring down the vehicle price to the lowest possible level.

This has been a very disappointing and unprofessional experience. I trusted CARS24 for transparency and fair dealing, but unfortunately, that trust has been broken.
